notes.title: Writer. Chapter 1 - Update.
notes.notes:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We've prepared a patch with updates:

1. Fixed the sound playback bug for mannequins.
2. Fixed the unlocking of two achievements.
3. Added tutorial notifications.
4. Notes no longer clip through other objects.
5. Removed the ability to bypass pursuing mannequins.
6. Added footstep sounds when the character walks with a camera.
7. Stamina is no longer consumed when the player is crouching.
8. Jumping has been removed.
9. Updated control settings.
10. Improved some visual elements for low settings.
11. Enhanced the behavior of certain decals.
12. Improved sound design.
